name: – Niclas Herbst – § 252, after point xiii – Am 89
title: REPORT on discharge in respect of the implementation of the general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2023, Section III – Commission, executive agencies and the ninth, tenth and eleventh European Development Funds
part_text: (xiii a) ensure immediate and complete access to grant contracts between the Commission and non-governmental and civil society organisations; this must be guaranteed for the European Parliament, the EU Member States and citizens, ensuring the effective exercise of public control;
